newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's Rexrodt says mark rates good for exports.
newsitem.headline: Germany's Rexrodt says mark rates good for exports.

text.p: German Economics Minister Guenter Rexrodt said on Friday mark exchange rate levels were good for German exports and reaffirmed the government's forecast that the economy would expand 2.5 percent this year.
"The world economy is pointed upwards again, and the mark exchange rate is favourable for exports," Rexrodt said in a prepared speech to be delivered in Frankfurt later in the day.
In a speech prepared for the Ambiente consumer goods industry trade fair, Rexrodt said the consumer goods industry would benefit from further economic expansion after 1.4-percent growth last year.
"Economic growth willl be clearly higher this year. I am counting on 2.5 percent," he said.
Rexrodt added that high unemployment was hurting domestic demand but that it was the government's highest priorty to cut the jobless rate.
